To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
RARalpha beta 2(-) mutant mice have impaired ureteric morphogenesis due to downregulated expression of the proto-oncogenic tyrosine kinase receptor c-ret. Retin
RARalpha beta(-) mutant mice have small kidneys, containing fewer nephrons and fewer ureteric bud tips than wild-type mice, due to impaired ureteric branching morphogenesis.
RARalpha beta(-) mutants lack stromal cells that mediate retinoids-dependent functions essential for ureteric branching morphogenesis.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and characterization of the signaling pathways that regulate the development of the embryonic kidney.
the role of retinoids in kidney development, and we are particularly interested in the role of retinoic acid receptors in the developing kidney.
the molecular mechanisms underlying retinoid-dependent regulation of renal development.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
retinoids, via their nuclear receptors RARs and RXRs, regulate renal morphogenesis by modulating the expression of c-ret, a proto-oncogene that is essential for collecting duct morphogenesis.

RARalpha beta 2(-) mutant mice display a phenotype of renal dysplasia with reduced ureteric bud growth and nephrogenesis, due to the absence of stromal cell-derived retinoid-dependent signals required for c-ret expression.

RARalpha beta 2(-) mice display a phenotype that resembles the renal phenotype of vitamin A-deficient rats and that the RARalpha beta double null mice are a good model for studying the function of retinoids in the kidney.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
RARalpha beta double mutants have a defect in the stromal cells, which leads to a decrease in c-ret expression in ureteric bud cells, and this results in a defect in ureteric branch morphogenesis.
retinoids are essential in the stromal cell compartment for the maintenance of ureteric bud development.
retinoids, via RARalpha and/or RARbeta2, are essential for generating stromal signals that maintain c- ret expression in the developing kidney.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the role of retinoids and retinoid receptors in renal development is cell type specific.
RARalpha beta 2(-) mutants provide a new model for investigating the role of stromal cells in renal morphogenesis and function.
stromal cells, which are not directly involved in nephrogenesis, play an important role in regulating nephron formation.
